en_title: 'It Would Be Absolutely Incredible' — Hideki Kamiya Wants to Make a New Castlevania Game With Konami
cn_title: 「那绝对会非常精彩」——Hideki Kamiya想与科乐美合作制作一款新的《恶魔城》游戏
opus_summary: 《Devil May Cry》及《Okami》的创作者Hideki Kamiya表示，希望与科乐美合作开发《Castlevania》新作，并称如果由他的团队制作，成品一定会非常出色。他目前正带领独立工作室CLOVERS开发《Okami》续作，也提出了与其他大型公司合作的想法。

paragraphs.en: Hideki Kamiya, the mind behind Devil May Cry , Bayonetta , and Okami , wants to make a new Castlevania game, saying his team at CLOVERS could make something "absolutely incredible" alongside Konami.
paragraphs.cn: 《鬼泣》《猎天使魔女》和《大神》背后的创作者神谷英树想制作一款新的《恶魔城》游戏。他表示，自己在CLOVERS的团队能够与科乐美共同打造出「绝对非常精彩」的作品。

paragraphs.en: Hideki Kamiya is back in the saddle at CLOVERS, his independent game studio made up of former CLOVER staff who are currently hard at work on the Okami sequel . He made the company’s independent status extremely clear in his latest YouTube video , reminding excited fans to stop asking him about Capcom-owned franchises (or even sequels to games like God Hand , since he had no part in its development).
paragraphs.cn: 神谷英树在自己的独立游戏工作室CLOVERS重新投入工作。该工作室由前CLOVER员工组成，目前正在努力开发《大神》续作。他在最新的YouTube视频中明确强调了公司作为独立工作室的地位，提醒兴奋的粉丝不要再问他有关卡普空旗下系列的问题（甚至也不要问《神之手》等游戏的续作，因为他没有参与该游戏的开发）。

paragraphs.en: Given CLOVERS’ status as an independent company that’s already working with a major developer in Capcom, Kamiya floated ideas for future collaborations with other big developers once the Okami sequel is out in the world. One of those ideas was a partnership with Konami for a Castlevania game, which he promised would be “incredible,” if it actually ends up happening.
paragraphs.cn: 鉴于CLOVERS是一家已经与卡普空这样的大型开发商合作的独立公司，Kamiya提出了一些想法，希望在《大神》续作推出后与其他大型开发商展开合作。其中一个想法是与科乐美合作制作一款《恶魔城》游戏，他承诺，如果这件事最终真的成行，作品将会「非常精彩」。

paragraphs.en: “Since we’re independent and don’t have any outside funding, we want to stay on good terms — or rather, collaborate — with various companies and keep doing interesting things,” he explained. “Of course, I want to keep building a good relationship with Capcom, and naturally, I’d like to be on good terms with Nintendo, too.
paragraphs.cn: 他解释道：「由于我们是独立的，没有任何外部资金，我们希望与各家公司保持良好关系——或者说，与它们合作——继续做有趣的事情。当然，我想继续与卡普空建立良好的关系，自然也希望与任天堂保持良好关系。

paragraphs.en: “...Maybe I could make a new Getsufumaden with Konami. Oh, and Castlevania. If we made it, it would be absolutely incredible, so please, let us take the job. I am a bit busy right now, though,” he laughed.
paragraphs.cn: 「……也许我可以和科乐美一起制作一款新的《月风魔传》。哦，还有《恶魔城》。如果由我们来做，那绝对会非常精彩，所以拜托，请把工作交给我们。不过我现在有点忙。」他笑着说道。

paragraphs.en: A Castlevania game from a mind like Kamiya’s would definitely be something special. Would it be a 3D action game like Bayonetta, or more of a 2D side-scroller in the vein of Viewtiful Joe ? The possibilities are endless, and given that Konami is already on a mission to revitalize its classic IPs with new games, the possibility of a team-up with CLOVERS on a Castlevania title isn’t totally out of the question.
paragraphs.cn: 由Kamiya这样的人构思的《恶魔城》游戏肯定会很特别。它会是像《猎天使魔女》那样的3D动作游戏，还是更像《红侠乔伊》那样的2D横向卷轴游戏？可能性无穷无尽，而且考虑到科乐美已经着手通过新游戏重振其经典IP，与CLOVERS联手制作一款《恶魔城》作品的可能性并非完全不存在。

paragraphs.en: It's also worth noting that the Castlevania franchise enjoyed a new installment in Belmont's Curse late last month. Alongside its animated adaptations on Netflix, Konami's classic vampire-slaying game series is getting a second wind, and Kamiya would like to be part of that, though whether or not this actually happens remains to be seen.
paragraphs.cn: 还值得注意的是，《恶魔城》系列上月底迎来了新作《Belmont's Curse》。加上Netflix上的动画改编作品，科乐美这个以猎杀吸血鬼为主题的经典游戏系列正焕发第二春，Kamiya希望参与其中，不过这是否真的会发生还有待观察。

paragraphs.en: Kamiya also brought up ideas for other potential games that CLOVERS might make in collaboration with big publishers in the future, though how serious he was about these is up to interpretation. He playfully mentioned making a Star Fox sequel with Koei Tecmo or a King’s Knight sequel with Square Enix, and even mentioned a Kinnikuman M.U.S.C.L.E.: Tag Team Match game with Bandai Namco. Of course, these are all just goofy ideas he likely said in jest, but it does seem like he’s eager to make more games with major companies once Okami is out the door.
paragraphs.cn: Kamiya还提出了CLOVERS未来可能与大型发行商合作制作的其他游戏的构想，不过他对这些想法有多认真，还要看个人理解。他开玩笑地提到与光荣特库摩制作《星际火狐》续作，或者与史克威尔艾尼克斯制作《King’s Knight》续作，甚至还提到与万代南梦宫制作一款《Kinnikuman M.U.S.C.L.E.: Tag Team Match》游戏。当然，这些都只是他很可能开玩笑说出的古怪想法，但他似乎确实渴望在《大神》推出后与大公司制作更多游戏。

paragraphs.en: The Okami sequel was first announced at the 2024 Game Awards. It’s only been two years since then, so it’s unlikely that we’ll hear anything else from CLOVERS about the game’s development process anytime soon. However, you can read our exclusive interview with Kamiya , done just after the sequel’s TGA announcement, or check out our chat with him from the Lucca Comics & Games Festival just last month.
paragraphs.cn: 《大神》续作于2024年游戏大奖上首次公布。距离那时才过去两年，因此我们不太可能在短期内从CLOVERS那里听到有关游戏开发进程的更多消息。不过，你可以阅读我们在续作于TGA公布后不久对Kamiya进行的独家采访，或者看看上个月我们在Lucca Comics & Games Festival上与他的访谈。
